InfoItems.Info: Converted GDTF to grandMA2 fixture type with Share Converter version 1.4.1
New fixture type based on WASH 1240B RGBL from PRstage

With 12x40W(RGBL) LEDs, variable motorized zoom (3.5 – 45 degrees), and individual pixel control, capable of creating a kaleidoscope effect. It not only has a beam zoom wash visual effect but also has built-in various macro function effects.
